title: Continuation and missing work
summary: Advance the dev2 source candidate through current-baseline qualification and then fill carrier/security extension gaps without bypassing the common socket authority.
invariants: Execute the expanded dev2 contract suite and independent COTS tests against Socket Provider dev16 before promotion.
Exercise fragmented TEXT and BINARY messages with interleaved PING/PONG and both local and peer close paths on wire.
Bind production nonce and masking entropy to an estate cryptographic/randomness authority; do not add shell-command crypto or ad-hoc weak randomness.
Add extension negotiation only through explicit extension objects and fail closed for unsupported negotiated extensions.
Treat RFC 8441 and RFC 9220 as explicit WebSocket-over-HTTP/2 and WebSocket-over-HTTP/3 compositions; ordinary RFC 6455 Upgrade does not implement them.
Keep browser, Queue Fabric, RPC, Wire UI and application semantics above WebSocket; they may consume the access class but do not own RFC 6455 framing.
Preserve full ooRexx objects through every selector/provider seam; do not flatten addresses, messages or authorities into dictionaries.
Use Rasen Falcon componentId websocket-access for every project request and unread reply check for this work.
